title: PresentationState
description: Presentation mode. While active the lighting mode is presentation unless a person overrides a zone.

active.description: True while presentation mode is on.

started_at.description: Start of the current presentation, ISO 8601 UTC, null when inactive.

started_by.description: Who started it, null when inactive.

lecture_id.description: Lecture the presentation belongs to, null when none.

PresentationStarter.title: PresentationStarter
PresentationStarter.description: app is POST /presentation, voice is a start_presentation intent, schedule is a lecture with lighting_mode presentation.
